summary: Practise fishery-lot inspection, traceability and evidence review using Codex and ISO references. Explore the five-day course.
lede: Fishery-product quality and compliance training helps quality officers, seafood processors and export teams assess lots against Codex guidance and buyer specifications. Participants practise turning requirements into inspection criteria, reviewing HACCP controls, and assembling sampling, laboratory, temperature and traceability evidence. They also draft lot disposition and corrective-action records to support clear acceptance decisions, escalation and buyer communication.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who assess fishery-product lots, maintain food-safety evidence or prepare products and records for buyer review. It suits intermediate learners with practical exposure to fish handling, processing, quality checks or food-safety controls.
modules: HACCP Process Flow and Control Records
prerequisites: Working familiarity with fishery-product handling, processing, quality checks or food-safety controls is expected. No coding or programming is required.
